cards.ex: The country is experiencing a significant brain drain as talented graduates seek better opportunities abroad.
cards.exUz: Iqtidorli bitiruvchilar xorijda yaxshiroq imkoniyatlarni qidirar ekan, mamlakatda sezilarli aqllar ketishi kuzatilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Mamlakatdan yuqori malakali mutaxassislarning boshqa davlatlarga ketishi.

cards.ex: The repetitive nature of the work was mind-numbing.
cards.exUz: Ishning bir xilligi juda zerikarli edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda zerikarli va fikrlash qobiliyatini susaytiruvchi.

cards.ex: His plans for the company were dismissed as a mere flight of fancy.
cards.exUz: Uning kompaniya uchun rejalari oddiy xayoliy o'ylar deb rad etildi.
cards.uzDef: Reallikdan uzoq, g'ayrioddiy xayollar yoki tasavvurlar.

cards.ex: Climbing Mount Everest requires not only physical strength but also immense mental fortitude.
cards.exUz: Everestga chiqish nafaqat jismoniy kuch, balki ulkan ruhiy matonatni ham talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga bardosh berish uchun ruhiy kuch va chidamlilik.

cards.ex: We can't lose sight of our long-term goals, even when faced with daily challenges.
cards.exUz: Kundalik qiyinchiliklarga duch kelgan taqdirda ham, uzoq muddatli maqsadlarimizni unutib qo'ymaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Muhim narsani unutish yoki e'tibordan chetda qoldirish.

cards.ex: Trying to understand his explanation required some serious mental gymnastics.
cards.exUz: Uning tushuntirishini tushunish uchun jiddiy aqliy mashqlar talab qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Murakkab va chalkash fikrlash yoki muammoni hal qilish.

cards.ex: The president assembled a brain trust to advise him on economic policy.
cards.exUz: Prezident iqtisodiy siyosat bo'yicha maslahat berish uchun aqllilar guruhini yig'di.
cards.uzDef: Maslahat berish va muammolarni hal qilish uchun yig'ilgan ekspertlar guruhi.

cards.ex: His judgment was clouded by anger, leading him to make a rash decision.
cards.exUz: Uning fikrlashi g'azabdan xiralashgan edi, bu esa uni shoshilinch qaror qabul qilishga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: His-tuyg'ular, stress yoki boshqa omillar tufayli to'g'ri fikrlay olmaslik.

cards.ex: I had a light bulb moment when I realized the solution to the puzzle.
cards.exUz: Boshqotirmaning yechimini anglaganimda, menda ayoniylik yuz berdi.
cards.uzDef: To'satdan tushunish yoki kashfiyot lahzasi.

cards.ex: I need to get something off my chest – I've been feeling really stressed lately.
cards.exUz: Dildagini aytishim kerak - oxirgi paytlarda o'zimni juda stressda his qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida gapirib, xotirjam bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: When I'm writing, I like to be in the zone, with no distractions.
cards.exUz: Yozayotganimda, hech qanday chalg'itadigan narsa bo'lmasligi uchun diqqat markazida bo'lishni xohlayman.
cards.uzDef: O'z ishiga to'liq berilib, a'lo darajada ishlayotgan holat.

cards.ex: I'm still trying to wrap my head around the new regulations.
cards.exUz: Men hali ham yangi qoidalarni tushunishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Murakkab yoki qiyin narsani tushunishga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: I lost my train of thought when the phone rang.
cards.exUz: Telefon jiringlaganda fikrlar zanjirimni yo'qotdim.
cards.uzDef: Bir-biri bilan bog'liq fikrlar ketma-ketligi.

cards.ex: She's very quick on the uptake, so she'll learn the job quickly.
cards.exUz: U juda tez fahmlaydi, shuning uchun u ishni tez o'rganadi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi narsalarni tez va oson o'rganadigan.

cards.ex: My grandfather has a memory like an elephant; he remembers everything from his childhood.
cards.exUz: Mening bobomning xotirasi kuchli; u bolaligidan hamma narsani eslaydi.
cards.uzDef: Hech narsani unutmaydigan juda yaxshi xotiraga ega odam.

cards.ex: After years of practice, driving became second nature to her.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yillik mashqdan so'ng, haydash unga odat tusiga kirdi.
cards.uzDef: Oson va tabiiy ravishda qilinadigan, o'rganishga hojat qolmagan narsa.

cards.ex: After weeks of intense studying, I was experiencing mental exhaustion.
cards.exUz: Bir necha haftalik qizg'in o'qishdan so'ng, men ruhiy charchoqni his qildim.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq muddatli stress yoki aqliy zo'riqish natijasida kelib chiqadigan holat.

cards.ex: I called to put your mind at ease about the test results; everything is fine.
cards.exUz: Test natijalari haqida sizni xotirjam qilish uchun qo'ng'iroq qildim; hamma narsa yaxshi.
cards.uzDef: Xavotir yoki qo'rquvni kamaytirish, biror kimni tinchlantirish.

cards.ex: The power of suggestion can be very strong, especially in advertising.
cards.exUz: Taklif kuchi, ayniqsa reklamada, juda kuchli bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Birovning fikri, his-tuyg'usi yoki xatti-harakatiga ta'sir o'tkazish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: Let's brainstorm some ideas for the new marketing campaign.
cards.exUz: Keling, yangi marketing kampaniyasi uchun bir nechta g'oyalar bilan bo'lishamiz.
cards.uzDef: Yangi g'oyalarni topish uchun birgalikda fikrlash.

cards.ex: Her stories are filled with flights of imagination.
cards.exUz: Uning hikoyalari xayol uchqunlari bilan to'la.
cards.uzDef: Ijodiy yoki g'ayrioddiy tasavvurlar.

cards.ex: I have a mental picture of what I want my future house to look like.
cards.exUz: Kelajakdagi uyim qanday ko'rinishga ega bo'lishi haqida tasavvurga egaman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida aniq tasavvurga ega bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: In retrospect, I should have taken the job offer.
cards.exUz: O'tmishga nazar solsak, men ish taklifini qabul qilishim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi voqealarni hozirgi nuqtai nazardan baholash.

cards.ex: Off the top of my head, I can't think of any other examples.
cards.exUz: Hozirgi fikrimcha, boshqa misollarni eslay olmayman.
cards.term: off the top of my head
cards.uzDef: O'ylamasdan yoki tayyorlanmasdan aytilgan narsa.

cards.ex: There's a touch of madness in his genius.
cards.exUz: Uning dahosida biroz telbalik bor.
cards.uzDef: Biroz g'alati yoki aqlsiz xatti-harakat.

cards.ex: I need a few minutes to get my thoughts together before the meeting.
cards.exUz: Uchrashuvdan oldin fikrlarimni tartibga solish uchun bir necha daqiqa kerak.
cards.uzDef: Fikrlashni to'xtatib, o'zingizni yig'ishtirib olmoq.

cards.ex: His actions were driven by deep-seated beliefs about justice.
cards.exUz: Uning harakatlari adolat haqidagi chuqur e'tiqodlariga asoslangan edi.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq ishonilgan va o'zgartirish qiyin bo'lgan e'tiqodlar.

cards.ex: Don't jump to conclusions; let's hear all the facts first.
cards.exUz: Shoshilinch xulosaga kelmang; avval hamma faktlarni eshitaylik.
cards.uzDef: Yetarli dalillarga ega bo'lmasdan xulosa chiqarish.

cards.ex: It was such a weight off my shoulders when I finally finished the project.
cards.exUz: Loyiha nihoyat tugagach, bu mening yelkamdan katta yuk tushgandek bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Muammo yoki tashvishdan xalos bo'lgandagi yengillik hissi.

cards.ex: Can I pick your brains about this problem I'm having at work?
cards.exUz: Ishda bo'layotgan muammo haqida sizning fikringizni so'rasam bo'ladimi?
cards.uzDef: Birovning bilimidan maslahat yoki fikr olish.
